description.value:
“You know how to wake dead metal just a little too well.”

When you finish a a Soma Break, you may choose one construct, device, vehicle, or weapon you repaired, salvaged, or forged during or before the rest.

  • For the next hour, it gains +1 to attack rolls (if it makes attacks) and +1 to Guard (if it can be targeted and has an Guard).
  • Once per round, the first time it hits or successfully completes a relevant action, it deals an extra 1d8 lightning or sephirotic damage (radiant) (your choice when you apply the overcharge).
  • If the item or construct is destroyed while overcharged, you immediately gain advantage on your next tool check and salvage action this scene, as the feedback pours a blueprint directly into your hands.

OP Echo. If you successfully reclaim at least one meaningful Material, Component, or OP via salvage during the hour, your faction gains +1 Economy OP for the next strategic turn (once per scenario).

system.requirements: Soul-Smith 15, Forge of the Spark Reclaimer
